digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter value maps and boundary guards
propositions: The ticket-type map (_LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE) is defined in two places: adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py and adapters/jira_datacenter/backend.py, creating a maintenance burden and divergence risk identical to the defect class fixed in story fe15.
The boundary guard that prevents duplicate status and priority maps does not cover the ticket-type map, leaving recurrence undetected.

An external consumer (test_outbound_differ_session_log_exclusion.py:87) reads _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE as a module attribute on outbound_fields, so any relocation must preserve that binding or the test must be updated.

The two existing ticket-type map literals are content-identical (same four keys and values, differing only in key order), so consolidation to adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py preserves behavior on both Cloud and DC deployments.

Both create paths must be pinned by value to verify they produce correct issuetype values after consolidation, and the boundary guard must be extended and mutation-checked to prevent future duplicates.
